01 · Yum China

KFC China

Building a distinctive burger category through positioning, integrated campaigns and social-first activation.

RoleBeef Burger Category Lead

Brand strategy · Campaign development · Media · Social & influencer

Challenge

Move KFC’s beef burger business from a succession of product launches toward a recognizable, long-term category position.

Strategy

Own a clear product truth—juiciness—and build an integrated platform connecting consumer insight, product positioning, creative development and media.

Execution

Led competitive pitches, aligned 5–8 agency partners, managed an annual media budget of approximately €2.4M and translated hero campaigns into platform-native social and creator assets.

Impact

A five-week campaign delivered 30M+ impressions. Category market share grew from 8% to 13% in one year, while cumulative sales surpassed 100M units.

02 · Founder project

Winenology

Creating a wine lifestyle brand—and its first audience—from an empty page.

RoleFounder & Brand Director

Positioning · Naming · Product · Website · Organic social · Creator seeding

Brand idea

A playful lifestyle brand that celebrates the beauty of the tipsy moment and makes wine culture feel less formal, more expressive and more wearable.

From strategy to product

Led positioning, naming, visual direction, product development and English website content. Extended one clear brand idea into the Wine Baguette Bag and “Chic Drinker” product family.

Organic growth

Built the social presence from scratch through original storytelling, consistent publishing and community-led content rather than paid media.

Creator model

Sourced, negotiated and managed 30+ creator partnerships through gifting and value exchange, keeping total spend under €1,000.

03 · Client project

The Angry Horse

Building a high-frequency content engine across cultures and platforms.

RoleSocial Strategy & Content Lead

Content operations · Localization · Short-form production · Organic growth

Content system

Built an end-to-end social operation producing more than 150 short-form videos at a sustainable rhythm of five posts per week.

Localization

Adapted French source material for Chinese and international audiences through new hooks, context, pacing, English subtitles and AI voiceovers.

Principle

Localization is not translation. The goal was to preserve the brand’s point of view while changing the storytelling code for each audience and platform.

Growth

With zero paid media, two Chinese social accounts grew to 5,000+ and 3,000+ followers within six months. Instagram reached 400+ followers in two weeks.
